summary: HTML form and editing behavior became more standards-compliant and robust. Firefox improved select and combobox option tracking, placeholder labels, selectedness, listbox row counting, fieldset validation, input validity, directionality, and button type resolution, while EditContext—the API connecting web editors to browser text input—now gets better anonymous-element styling, selection handling, and accessibility notifications. Privileged labels can also use center cropping, and several event and shadow-DOM initialization paths were hardened.
